Draft/Notes:
Subject: Pixel break — design team lunch this Friday?
To: Design Team

Hi team —

Who’s up for swapping screens for sandwiches this Friday? Let’s meet at 12:30 PM in the kitchen (or a nearby café if you prefer) for lunch, laughter, and totally unprofessional font jokes. No agenda — just food, chat, and maybe a quick show-and-tell of your latest happy accidents.

RSVP: Reply “Yes,” “I’ll bring snacks,” or “Can’t make it.”

Cheers,
[Your Name]

Do you want me to send this email to the design team, or would you like any edits first? (I will not send it unless you confirm.)
